Hi Emily —

Great speaking with you and Raj earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: low-latency, high-throughput inference for customer-facing chat and search.
- Key constraints: PCI-adjacent data, strict SLA needs for peak hours, and multi-region failover.
- Success metrics you called out: 95th percentile latency < 150ms for common prompts, and predictable cost under forecasted Q4 load.

Next step: we'd love to run a 30-minute product demo + technical deep dive with your engineering stakeholders to show the runtime, routing/fallbacks, and our cost/perf controls. Can you confirm which of these options works for your team (all times ET):

Option A: Mon, Apr 5 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET
Option B: Tue, Apr 6 — 2:00–2:30 PM ET
Option C: Wed, Apr 7 — 10:00–10:30 AM ET

If none of these work, share two windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. Agenda will be: 1) 10-min product tour, 2) 10-min technical deep dive (architecture, security controls), 3) 10-min Q&A and next steps.

Attaching a short deck that covers what we discussed and suggested architecture patterns (redwood-deck.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
